_comment: Built-in productivity tips shown at pomodoro breaks. Written for Eselsbrücke; MIT like the plugin.

tips.title: Time-box the next task
tips.why: A fixed slot turns 'until it is done' into 'until 11:30', which makes starting easier and stops polishing.

tips.title: Eat the frog
tips.why: Do the task you are avoiding first: the rest of the day no longer carries it.

tips.title: Two-minute rule
tips.why: If it takes under two minutes, do it now; writing it down costs about as much.

tips.title: Shutdown ritual
tips.why: End the day by writing tomorrow's first step on the pad, so you can stop thinking about work.

tips.title: Write the next physical step
tips.why: 'Fix export' stalls; 'open export.ts and log the payload' starts.

tips.title: One thing per block
tips.why: Switching between tasks costs more focus than it feels like; keep one task per pomodoro.

tips.title: Look away from the screen
tips.why: Twenty seconds at something twenty feet away rests the eyes better than scrolling.

tips.title: Stand up and move
tips.why: A short walk in the break resets attention more than another tab does.

tips.title: Drink some water
tips.why: Mild thirst lowers concentration before you notice it.

tips.title: Batch the shallow work
tips.why: Answer messages in one block instead of between deep tasks.

tips.title: Note what you finished
tips.why: A short done list makes progress visible on days that feel slow.

tips.title: Park stray thoughts
tips.why: Write a distracting thought on the pad and return to the task; it will still be there at the break.
